. ./api/_lib/pantry-store.ps1
. ./api/_lib/pantry-render.ps1
$pass=0;$fail=0
function ok($c,$m){ if($c){$script:pass++}else{$script:fail++;Write-Host "FAIL: $m" -Foreground Red} }

$items = @(
  [pscustomobject]@{ id=1; name="Rice";  quantity=0;  threshold=1; category="Grains"; expiry=$null; unit="kg" }
  [pscustomobject]@{ id=2; name="Beans"; quantity=1;  threshold=1; category="Grains"; expiry=$null; unit="cans" }
  [pscustomobject]@{ id=3; name="Oil";   quantity=5;  threshold=2; category="Oils";   expiry=$null; unit="btl" }
  [pscustomobject]@{ id=4; name="Salt";  quantity=2;  threshold=1; category="Spices"; expiry=$null; unit="g" }
  [pscustomobject]@{ id=5; name="Amaranth"; quantity=0.5; threshold=1; category="Grains"; expiry=$null; unit="kg" }
  [pscustomobject]@{ id=6; name="NoThresh"; quantity=1; threshold=$null; category="X"; expiry=$null; unit="" }  # default 1 -> 1<=1 low
  [pscustomobject]@{ id=7; name="NoThreshHigh"; quantity=2; threshold=$null; category="X"; expiry=$null; unit="" } # default 1 -> 2<=1 not low
)

$low = @(Select-PantryLowStockItems -Items $items)
$names = $low.name -join ","
ok ($low.Count -eq 4) "count should be 4, got $($low.Count): $names"
ok ($names -eq "Amaranth,Beans,NoThresh,Rice") "name-sorted low set, got: $names"
ok ($low.name -notcontains "Oil") "Oil (5>2) excluded"
ok ($low.name -notcontains "Salt") "Salt (2>1) excluded"
ok ($low.name -notcontains "NoThreshHigh") "NoThreshHigh (2>default1) excluded"
ok ($low.name -contains "NoThresh") "NoThresh (1<=default1) included"

# empty input
ok ((@(Select-PantryLowStockItems -Items @())).Count -eq 0) "empty input -> 0"
# none qualifying
$hi = @([pscustomobject]@{id=1;name="A";quantity=9;threshold=1})
ok ((@(Select-PantryLowStockItems -Items $hi)).Count -eq 0) "no qualifying -> 0"

# render list
$html = Format-PantryLowStockListHtml -Items $low
ok ($html -match "id=.lowstock-list.") "list wrapper id present"
ok ($html -match "hx-get=./htmx/lowstock-list.") "list self-fetch url"
ok ($html -match "itemChanged from:body") "list listens itemChanged"
ok ($html -match "item-row-1") "reuses item row (Rice id 1)"
$empty = Format-PantryLowStockListHtml -Items @()
ok ($empty -match "Nothing running low") "empty state text"
ok ($empty -match "id=.lowstock-list.") "empty still has wrapper"

# count badge

ok ($c4 -match "hx-get=./htmx/lowstock-count.") "count self-fetch url"
ok ($c4 -match ">4<") "count shows 4"
ok ($c4 -match "4 items at or below") "plural aria label"
$c1 = Format-PantryLowStockCountHtml -Count 1
ok ($c1 -match "1 item at or below") "singular aria label"
$c0 = Format-PantryLowStockCountHtml -Count 0
ok ($c0 -match "id=.nav-lowstock-count.") "zero still listening span"
ok ($c0 -notmatch "rounded-full") "zero renders no pill"

Write-Host "PASS=$pass FAIL=$fail"
if($fail -gt 0){ exit 1 }'

B=http://localhost:8433 # find LowMilk's id from edit-able rows in the list id=$(curl -s "$B/htmx/lowstock-list" | grep -oP "item-row-\d+" | sort -u | while read r; do n=$(echo $r | grep -oP "\d+"); row=$(curl -s "$B/htmx/item-row?id=$n"); if echo "$row" | grep -q "LowMilk"; then echo $n; fi done) echo "LowMilk id=$id" # raise quantity to 5 (above threshold 1) via update resp=$(curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -X PUT "$B/htmx/item-update" --data-urlencode "id=$id" --data-urlencode "name=LowMilk" --data-urlencode "quantity=5" --data-urlencode "threshold=1" --data-urlencode "category=Dairy" --data-urlencode "unit=cartons") echo "$resp" | grep -i "HX-Trigger" echo "=== count after raise ==="; curl -s "$B/htmx/lowstock-count" | grep -oP "aria-label='[^']+'|>\d+" | head -1 echo "=== LowMilk still in list? ==="; curl -s "$B/htmx/lowstock-list" | grep -c "LowMilk"
